title: Unhandled KeyError in inventory reservation when item ID is not in catalog
description: When orders are placed for discontinued or external vendor items, the cart reservation endpoint crashes with a 500 error due to an unhandled KeyError in the inventory lookup.
error_log:
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File 'app/services/inventory_service.py', line 20, in reserve_stock
    available = STOCK_CATALOG[item_id]
KeyError: 'ITEM-999_UNKNOWN'
recent_changes: Commit 82d109: Added rapid checkout reservation caching
expected_behavior: Should check if item exists via get() and return {'success': False, 'reason': 'Item not found'} without crashing
actual_behavior: Throws unhandled KeyError causing 500 Internal Server Error
